poll.source_locator: p1 release: 'Moody leads Democrat Angie Nixon 49% to 45%'; '3% remain undecided and 3% prefer another candidate'; Table 1 (p.38) All likely voters 49/45/3/3, n 859
poll.notes: Electoral items computed on 861 self-reported registered voters weighted by modeled turnout probability (already-voted fixed at 1), described as 'likely voters'; 55% of weighted LV report having voted. Undecided leaners allocated. Wikipedia lists '852 (RV)'; the report says the estimates are likely-voter estimates. Opt-in Qualtrics panel; +/-3.6 is a design-effect-adjusted precision estimate, not an MoE.

pollster.weighting_quote: w_weight is the electoral weight, computed among registered voters (n = 861): respondents are raked to the demographic margins above plus the certified 2024 Florida presidential result (Trump 56.09%, Harris 42.99%, other 0.92%, scaled to the share of respondents reporting a 2024 vote), and the resulting weight is multiplied by each respondent's predicted likelihood of voting
